categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: online gaming, cloud services, and digital twin & cultural tourism. The gaming segment includes development and operation of red-themed games, casual, sports, and social entertainment games. The cloud services segment provides IDC (Internet Data Center) services, including data center operations and value-added cloud services. The digital twin and cultural tourism segment focuses on immersive digital experiences and cultural IP-based tourism projects.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary game development technologies, including client-server architecture for online games, integration of VR/AR and cloud gaming technologies. Cloud services utilize Tier 3+ and national A-level data center infrastructure with smart, flexible, and green computing architectures. Digital twin technologies combine IoT, AI, cloud computing, and VR/AR for immersive cultural and tourism applications. The company also emphasizes continuous R&D and innovation in game design and cloud computing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual gamers, internet platforms, government agencies, financial institutions, and large enterprises requiring cloud and data center services. The gaming market targets domestic and overseas players, with a focus on patriotic and culturally themed games. Cloud services cater to telecom operators and enterprise clients across China. The digital twin and cultural tourism business serves cultural tourism operators and visitors, focusing on heritage sites like the Great Wall and regional tourism projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with data centers in Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Leshan. It also has overseas subsidiaries in Hong Kong, the United States, and the British Virgin Islands. The gaming business targets both domestic and international markets, with efforts to expand overseas game publishing and distribution. Cloud services focus on major Chinese economic regions including the Greater Bay Area and western China. Cultural tourism projects are located in culturally significant Chinese regions such as Hunan and Beijing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the digital entertainment and cloud service supply chains. It develops and operates games (downstream), provides cloud infrastructure and value-added services (midstream), and integrates digital twin technologies for cultural tourism (downstream). It collaborates with upstream telecom operators for bandwidth and infrastructure resources but mainly focuses on service provision and content creation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening the red-themed gaming brand, expanding multi-genre game portfolios, and enhancing overseas market penetration. The company invests in cloud computing and AI-driven smart data center services, aiming to increase cabinet utilization and develop cloud value-added offerings. It is advancing digital twin technology applications in various industries, especially cultural tourism, to create immersive experiences and digital IP. R&D focuses on game innovation, cloud infrastructure optimization, and integration of emerging technologies like VR/AR and AI.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through online game sales including virtual item sales and subscription fees, cloud service fees from data center rentals and value-added services, and digital twin & cultural tourism project income. The gaming segment includes direct sales, platform cooperation revenue sharing, and advertising agency fees. Cloud services earn from IDC resource leasing, bandwidth sales, and technical support services. Digital twin and cultural tourism revenues come from immersive experience projects and related cultural IP commercialization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in the Chinese online gaming and cloud services markets, facing competition from established game developers and major cloud service providers. It positions itself as a niche leader in patriotic-themed games and a growing player in cloud IDC services with strategic data center locations. Its digital twin and cultural tourism business is emerging, leveraging unique cultural IP and immersive technology to differentiate from competitors. The company emphasizes innovation and multi-segment synergy to maintain competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 227 million, a 12.3% decrease from 2023, with net losses narrowing to about RMB 52.7 million. The cloud services segment showed slight revenue growth and stable cash flow, while gaming revenue declined due to product lifecycle and market factors. The company has total assets around RMB 832 million and equity of RMB 406 million, with ongoing investments in cloud infrastructure and digital twin projects. R&D expenses decreased by 32.6%, reflecting project adjustments. The company faces profitability challenges but is focusing on strategic restructuring and growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through its focus on patriotic and culturally rich gaming content, appealing to national sentiment and niche markets. It combines traditional gaming with emerging technologies like VR/AR and cloud gaming to enhance user experience. In cloud services, it offers high-quality, secure, and efficient data center solutions with strong telecom partnerships. Its digital twin and cultural tourism projects provide immersive, technology-driven cultural experiences, leveraging unique IP such as the Great Wall. The integrated multi-segment business model aims to create sustainable competitive advantages and diversified revenue streams.
